kind: Independent acceptance plan, not executed results
business_basis: Initial file-sharing request in the independent conversation
Latest actual question replies: owner designates reviewer, all three parties notified
Recipient list contains authorized files only
Owner cancels pending requests and revokes approved shares
Revocation rejects new requests from unchanged pages and old download URLs
Drive mode; SQLite and SQLAlchemy; project-local synthetic data

business_cases.expectation: Real login establishes the application identity; unauthenticated protected requests are refused
An authenticated upload persists exact file bytes and metadata
Owner names a recipient and reviewer; request starts pending without granting download
Recipient cannot list or download a pending share
Only the designated reviewer can resolve that request
Approval grants the designated recipient access to the original bytes
Rejection grants no download permission and does not list the file for the recipient
Owner, designated reviewer and recipient receive the confirmed review result/shared-file notifications
Owner can cancel a pending request; cancellation grants no download
Owner revocation immediately rejects subsequent downloads using an already displayed URL
The application's authoritative effects remain correct with observation on, off and failing

mapping_cases.expectation: Independently scan all business files, handlers, functions and key parameters, including login and notifications
Each configured layer matches current source, declarations and data models; unresolved links remain explicit
Business, native states, shared policy, API, functions/values, data operations, project tree, code symbols and data structure are explicitly connected
Registered meanings match actual events; generic returns and exceptions do not invent business outcomes; waiting intervals and actual handoffs remain visible
Graph polling, source reads, viewer controls, preferences, recording and replay add zero business events
A source-only change or omitted required capture is rejected by the connected gate, then passes after repair
An ordinary business change refreshes all affected layers, source hashes, runtime build and checks without a manual graph-maintenance request
Stable IDs, individual positions, expansion, notes and filters survive the changed graph; obsolete recordings leave the current list

viewer_groups: English and Chinese; exact and explained names; identity preservation
Every preset view, advanced details, local code, project tree, complete code
Search, focus, breadcrumbs, expand/collapse, group drag, pan, zoom, fit
Arrange, undo, pins and persisted coordinates
2D/3D parity, perspective orbit, compact layer ruler, visibility, reordering and spacing
Straight, curved, orthogonal and bus routing; recalculation after geometry changes
Node and edge menus, annotations, core marking, Delete hide and All elements restore
Type, relation, region, depth and explicit-item filters; create, reload and delete custom view
Full source loading and accurate symbol/parameter highlighting without embedding copied files
Start/stop/clear recording, full and focused capture, recording export
Replay previous/next/play/pause, speed, granularity, locate, skip, loop and return to live
Timeline live/active/saved, duration and wait segments, directed same-track/cross-layer links
Timeline hover, exact event seek, event payload, graph locate and fixed-event animation
Timeline pan/zoom, wheel and keyboard, overview, range, depth/single-layer, expand tracks, dock resize/maximize
View/settings persistence, observer isolation, responsive viewport and large-record regression
